summary.en: The camera pushes in on the anchor while the mark inks up out of it, then pulls back on a log scale into the whole mark; name and line rise beside it; the plate takes one dot-gain impression.
summary.zh: 镜头推近锚点，标志的黑版从锚点向外上墨，随后按对数尺度拉远露出整个标志；名字和标语在旁边升起；黑版最后压一次网点扩大。

fits: The lock-up of a film whose recurring anchor is a piece of the product mark.
notFor: Marks without a separable piece; word-only marks.

intent.en: The reveal that the anchor was part of the mark all along: the camera pulls back and the rings of the film were its arcs.
intent.zh: 揭示锚点从头就是标志的一部分：镜头拉远，片里的圆环原来是它的弧线。

content.en: The product name (≤ 12 chars, Latin), a line (≤ 28 / 14 字), the mark as SVG paths with the anchor's box.
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 12 字符，拉丁字母），一行字（≤ 28 字符 / 14 字），以 SVG 路径给出的标志与锚点框。

fits.zh: 贯穿锚点是产品标志一部分的片子的落版。

notFor.zh: 拆不出一块的标志；纯文字标志。

en: Leave 1–2 s without the bed for the push-in; the silence makes the pull-back land.
zh: 推近时留 1–2 秒没有音乐床；静默让拉远落得住。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
